mistakes.why: That starts the count at 0. The interval starts at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = 1</annotation></semantics></math>, so add 1: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>4</mn><mi>i</mi></mrow><mi>n</mi></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x_i = 1 + \frac{4i}{n}</annotation></semantics></math>.
